userPrompt: Give me a recipe idea using eggs and spinach.
responseText:
**Spinach and Egg Skillet**

Sauté a handful of fresh spinach in olive oil with minced garlic until wilted (1–2 min).  

Crack 2–3 eggs directly on top, season with salt, pepper, and a pinch of chili flakes. Cover and cook until whites set but yolks are still runny (3–4 min).  

Finish with grated Parmesan or a squeeze of lemon. Serve straight from the pan with crusty bread or over toast.  

Quick, high-protein, one-pan meal.
